new_generation_provenance.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Show exactly this same creature from directly BEHIND at the SAME modest camera elevation as reference, roughly 15 degrees above horizontal. Rotate only yaw180 from front, no overhead camera. Rear silhouette should be broad and low, not tall: hind haunch fills foreground, front head immediately behind it is largely hidden, only the crown and ears visible ABOVE the rear haunch. The longitudinal body axis points straight away, strongly foreshortened, not laid out vertically as two top-view circles. Keep feet on a horizontal ground level with two near hind paws and two far front paws naturally occluded. One short tail attached centrally behind, slightly curled to one side. Zero visible eyes/nose/tusks from behind. Same two body masses, four paws, two ears, slate-blue layered fur with cream patches, same body proportions and gentle crouch as source. No extra anatomy, wings or text. One full-body sprite centered on genuine transparency with ample margin, same illustrated style.

Preserve exact silhouette, proportions and occlusion. Slate-blue layered fur, cream patches, two body masses, four broad paws, two ears and one short tail. Straight rear, low camera angle with near haunch occluding most of front head, no visible eyes/nose/tusks. Preserve rear paws and tail curl. Do not show extra body top surfaces or turn to an oblique view. Crisp low-resolution clusters, at most32 visible colors, no antialiasing/gradients. Transparent background, whole figure centered with generous margin, no text or extra parts.

Front paws overlap in depth more strongly. Keep same modest source camera elevation and full body length. Preserve the exact same individual: two connected furry body masses, larger front head/chest and round rear haunch, exactly four short broad paws with slate toe tips, two small round ears, two dark eyes and two pale fan-shaped tusks on FRONT only, one short rear tail. Preserve body attachment roots, gentle crouch, dark outline and soft cel shaded game illustration. Center whole figure with generous transparent margin. No text or scenery.
